wipeHelpLead: Thelekisa le mifanekiso mibini usebenzisa isahluli.
wipeHelpPointer: Rhuqa isibambo esijikelezileyo, okanye cofa naphi na kumfanekiso ukuze uhambise isahluli apho.
fadeHelpLead: Tshintsha kancinci phakathi kwale mifanekiso mibini.
fadeHelpPointer: Rhuqa isilayidi esingaphantsi komfanekiso, okanye cofa kwindawo ethile kuso.
